result.summary: Fixed scripts/goal023-retention-migration-rehearsal.mjs to expand the shared _goal004 AI durability database with the Goal023 migration and a missing AiToolCall fixture; validate:integration now passes all 28 steps.
result.report:
Root cause: `scripts/goal023-retention-migration-rehearsal.mjs` (added in this Goal, presumably by WU-09) only applied the new `Conversation.contentExpiredThrough` migration to its own throwaway `_goal023_ai` database, but never expanded the shared `AI_TEST_DATABASE_URL` database (`_goal004`, the one `goal004-migration-rehearsal.mjs` builds and every later Goal expands with its own migration) — unlike every other per-Goal rehearsal script in this repo (goal005, goal006, goal011, goal012, goal013, goal019 all follow a `prepareAiDurabilityTarget`-style expansion). Because `test:ai-orchestrator-transport-durability` (which runs `tests/integration/inbox-dispatch.test.ts`) connects to `_goal004`, its `Conversation.upsert()` failed with "column contentExpiredThrough does not exist" — exactly the failure quoted in the Work Unit.

Fix: added a `prepareAiDurabilityTarget(aiTarget)` function to `goal023-retention-migration-rehearsal.mjs`, called from `main()` after the three per-app rehearsals, which connects to `${database}_goal004`, confirms `Conversation` exists there, and applies the `20260915160000_goal023_conversation_content_expiry` migration.

Running the gate exposed a second, related gap once the first one was fixed and the gate runner (which stops at the first failure) reached further: `test:ai-orchestrator-content-purge` — also a brand-new step wired into `scripts/validate-integration.mjs` in this Goal — failed because `_goal004` never had an `AiToolCall` table at all (the hand-rolled legacy fixture in `goal004-migration-rehearsal.mjs` never included it, and no migration in this repo's history "creates" it from scratch — it originates from a pre-existing rename migration). This is the same class of gap (missing shared-fixture table) and blocks the exact same deterministic check named in the Work Unit's acceptance criteria, so I extended `prepareAiDurabilityTarget` to also create the `AiToolCall` table/enum/FK/index (matching `schema.prisma`'s `AiToolCall` model) as a fixture, not a production migration, guarded with `IF NOT EXISTS`/`duplicate_object` for idempotency.

Commands actually executed (from the worktree root):
- `node --check scripts/goal023-retention-migration-rehearsal.mjs` → OK (twice, after each edit).
- Started the repo's documented disposable local Postgres cluster (`pg_ctl start` on `127.0.0.1:55432`, already initialized at `/c/tmp/atendly-pgtest`, per `docs/migration/VALIDATION_GATE.md`).
- `BFF_TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgresql://pgtest@127.0.0.1:55432/atendly_bff_test" npm run validate:integration` — first run (after only the `contentExpiredThrough` fix): 26/28 passed, `test:ai-orchestrator-content-purge` failed (`AiToolCall` table missing), `test:evolution-go-webhook-outbox` not run.
- Same command again after adding the `AiToolCall` fixture: **28/28 passed, exit 0** — `validate:integration PASSED against 127.0.0.1:55432/atendly_bff_test.`
- Stopped the disposable Postgres cluster (`pg_ctl stop -m fast`) to leave the environment as found.
- `git status --short` confirms the only file touched is `scripts/goal023-retention-migration-rehearsal.mjs` (already untracked, owned by this Goal); no other Work Unit's files were reverted or altered.

Did not touch `scripts/validate-integration.mjs` itself, disable/skip/loosen any check, or touch any other app/module code — the fix is entirely inside the one migration-rehearsal script this Goal owns.

acceptance.criterion: A verificação "validate-integration" passa (exit 0) sem que ela própria tenha sido alterada, desabilitada ou afrouxada.
acceptance.detail: Ran `BFF_TEST_DATABASE_URL=... npm run validate:integration` against the documented local disposable Postgres cluster: 28/28 steps passed, exit 0, summary line "validate:integration PASSED against 127.0.0.1:55432/atendly_bff_test." scripts/validate-integration.mjs was not modified.

acceptance.criterion: Nenhum critério de aceite já atendido por outra Work Unit foi revertido.
acceptance.detail: git status --short after the fix shows only scripts/goal023-retention-migration-rehearsal.mjs changed (still untracked, new in this Goal); all other files remain exactly as they were at session start, and all previously-passing gate steps (bff, scheduling, evolution-go, and every prior per-Goal rehearsal) still passed in the final run.
